notes: Verified in app.asar: thread.new is mod+n on desktop (services/system/app-keybindings.ts) and the File > New Thread menu accelerator is CommandOrControl+N (src/desktop-menu-shortcuts.ts).
Verified: Enter submits the composer; steerActiveThreadOnEnter defaults true, so Enter steers a running thread instead of queueing.

Verified: sidebar.organizationMode defaults to chronological and sidebar.chronologicalSort to updated, which reorders threads on open or answer; configure sets it to created so A11's Cmd+1/Cmd+2 keep pointing at the same threads.

UNRESOLVED: model, effort and permission defaults for new threads live in bb.db (projectExecutionDefaults: providerId, model, reasoningLevel, permissionMode, serviceTier) and are only written when a thread is created from the app (origin app). BB 0.46.1 has no CLI or JSON file for them. Until the GUI session sets them once (model picker Cmd+Shift+M, reasoning Alt+T, permission picker) or a seeded ~/.bb/bb.db is restored, new threads run medium effort with permission auto and the provider's default model.
Provider ids are claude-code, codex and pi (builtin plugin manifests). defaultProviderId only picks the provider, not the model.
Permission modes: accept-edits, auto (factory default for new threads) and full. The local host's ceiling defaults to full.
Telemetry: PostHog to us.i.posthog.com, gated by BB_TELEMETRY at server start and by the telemetryEnabled app setting; configure sets the setting with bb settings general.

Auto-update: macOS always enables electron-updater (dist/desktop-update-provider.ts) with autoDownload false and autoInstallOnAppQuit true, so a downloaded update installs on the next quit and changes the version under the gate. No setting disables it; block github.com for the bb block or accept the version drift.

Onboarding: the setup guide shows while generalSettings.onboardingCompletedAt is null, which is the case after every reset. afterLaunch sets it through bb settings general; if the overlay stays open, dismiss it with a key or click found in the GUI session.
No prompt-rewriting feature exists in 0.46.1 (no enhance-rewrite control in app.asar or the server bundle), so there is nothing to turn off.
BB_CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE unset means the provider spawns claude from PATH (provider-claude-code), i.e. the system Claude Code; Codex runs through codex app-server.
Title side call: a prompt of five words or more gets a model-generated title (services/threads/title-generation.ts, generateThreadMetadata), so B1 counts it; short prompts such as hi do not.

C1: agents spawn child threads with bb thread spawn --parent-self (bb-cli skill). orchestrationTrigger /bb-cli is an ESTIMATE: the builtin skill is exposed as a slash command, and the C1 prompt needs it to know the spawn command. Verify in the GUI.

openProject runs bb project create --name arena --root ${worktree} with the bundled host-daemon CLI run by /opt/homebrew/bin/node, because the launcher at ~/.bb/bin/bb lives inside the data folder that reset moves aside. A second create in the same data folder makes a second project named arena.

Data: ~/.bb (~1.5 GB, bb.db 713 MB plus worktrees and logs) and ~/Library/Application Support/bb (window-state.json, cookies). Only ~/.bb is in dataDirs because moveAside names the aside folder after the basename and both would become bb.
processNames cover the app binary and its four helpers; the managed server and host daemon run from the same Electron binary with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE.

2026-11-11, C1: bb's orchestration is child threads (bb thread spawn --parent-self), each a client session of its own. C1 counts only with two sessions at work (orchestration.workers); subagents inside the lead's session are Claude Code's, not bb's.

2026-11-11: calibration.probe xkvw. The composer's placeholder ('Ask anything. @ to mention files, folders, or sections') holds pairs of the default probe ademarkqz ('de' in folder, and for Traycer 'ma' in commands), and the native rule takes any new probe pair in the region as Ready. On 10 and 11 Nov every A1 and A2 repetition reached Ready on the placeholder (frames.json: the Ready frame reads the placeholder, the caret blinks over its first letter, and no typed letter ever shows, because the typing stops at Ready). No ordinary word has xk, kv, vw or wx, so Ready can only be typed text. The rows of those nights were invalid ('Ready came from text that is not the probe'), never a false time.
